question: Should the repository authorize the exact-head `libphonenumber-js` dependency-graph update after its resolved package and supply-chain impact are reviewed?
rationale: The existing dependency guard explicitly reserves approval of this graph change to an administrator or security reviewer; code review cannot safely substitute for that authorization.

options.title: Authorize after dependency review
options.body: Review the manifest, shrinkwrap, and lockfile delta for the rebased head, then authorize the one package addition if it is acceptable.

options.title: Avoid the new dependency
options.body: Replace the parsing dependency with an existing maintained dependency or a narrow plugin-local approach only if it preserves international-number correctness.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the PR open until dependency authorization and real-device proof are available for a current, clean head.

recommendation.title: Authorize after dependency review
recommendation.body: Review the manifest, shrinkwrap, and lockfile delta for the rebased head, then authorize the one package addition if it is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: The dependency guard names this group as the required authorization path.
